'''''Revella's Journey: A Story of a Girl and Her Droid''''' was a popular children's [[holo-series]]<ref name="EGTD" /> published by [[Millennium Entertainments]]. The story featured a young girl named [[Revella]], and her companion [[GV/3-series guardian droid]], [[Seti]]. Seti was intent on protecting his mistress from Rebels intent on capturing her.<ref name="GFT" /> When the GV/3 [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was featured in the series, the positive reception that it received led to an increase in the purchase of the model by families.<ref name="EGTD" />
